summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with strong embedded systems and real-time firmware experience. Developed production-grade embedded systems using C/C++, FreeRTOS, and real-time control on STM32 and NVIDIA Jetson platforms. Proficient in motor control, sensor integration (UART/I2C/SPI), and hardware-software integration with demonstrated expertise in debugging complex embedded systems.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via real-time signal processing.
Implemented custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning for robust real-time operation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led 25-member robotics team owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and firmware integration; designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for 10+ robot platforms.
Implemented sensor communication protocols (UART, I2C) with closed-loop feedback on Arduino-based motor control systems for real-time locomotive robot operation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) – MS Capstone
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) through hardware-software integration debugging on Jetson+Arduino distributed system.

Built real-time vision-guided pick-and-place system: Implemented two-link inverse kinematics in Arduino C++, drove five servos via PWM with range-gated contact detection using dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via TCA9548A I2C mux.
Integrated real-time sensor fusion pipeline (faster-whisper STT, Gemini classification, TensorRT-optimized YOLO 5.2× speedup) with servo control achieving 11.5s end-to-end voice-to-pick latency.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control on STM32 with interrupt-driven UART command handling and real-time sensor coordination using FreeRTOS mutexes for shared-memory task synchronization.
Integrated YOLOv8 object detection on NVIDIA Jetson with real-time servo motor feedback control and VL53L0X ToF distance sensing for autonomous tracking.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed Cortex-M4 peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM footprint with deterministic 1 Hz real-time update rate.

Implemented timer-triggered ADC conversions with interrupt-driven sample capture and low-level I2C driver for temperature sensor communication; verified functionality in Proteus simulation and on hardware.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection (2023)
